scientific_limitations: The classification and integral lattice presentation are confined to the sixteen-vertex degree-five folded five-cube. This calculation does not classify all folded cubes, and bibliographic searches cannot establish absolute priority.
title: Ten minimal octahedral carriers generate the integral homology of the folded five-cube
